correctness.rationale: The equilibrium age density lambda/k e^{-lambda t}sum_{j=0}^{k-1}(lambda t)^j/j! has characteristic function phi_k=(1/k)sum_{j=1}^k(1-ix)^{-j}. Spectral expansion gives F-P=sum_{j,l}w_jw_l[Re(phi)-|phi|²]. With y=x², the scalar difference is y Q_k(y)/(k²(1+y)^k) and Q_k coefficients are exact binomial combinations. Independent rational-polynomial Sturm root counts give zero positive roots for each k=2..13 and exactly two for k=14; exact rational brackets and x=1/sqrt3 witness checked. For all k>=15, choosing x_k=tan((7pi/3)/k) gives a positive expression M_k, bounded below by positive rational inequality using q_k=cos^k((7pi/3)/k)>3/20. Near zero, D_k=-(k²-1)x²/12+O(x^4); at infinity D_k≈-1/(k²x²). The latter analytic inequalities, not extrapolated finite Sturm computations, establish all higher k. These results exclude mixed resets and non-Erlang laws.
residual_risks: The finite computations alone do not establish unrestricted hypotheses, parameter domains or infinite quantifiers; proof reconstruction supplies those steps.
